text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
—Um, Pokke-san, want to join in too?
Joint training! We're all about to do it together...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Mmmh... Sorry, I'll pass today.
Just not feeling it.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Pokke-san seems... kinda off?
She didn't do after-school training yesterday either, right?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Is she gonna be okay?
If you don't run every day, you get rusty so fast...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—One day after school.
While taking a walk for a change of pace,
I spotted Jungle Pocket by the riverbank.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She is a horse girl who always puts on fierce races
worthy of the name "Raging Battle Demon"...
Yet here she is, giving off this kind of vibe...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rest is important, but taking too long of a break
makes it take longer to get back in top form.
As a trainer at the academy, I grew concerned.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It might be none of my business,
but I stepped forward to call out to her... when suddenly!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
choice_data_list: (Th-This feeling is...! What in the world?!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My knees shook, and before I knew it, I fell right onto my backside.
My heart was pounding wildly in my chest...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Are you alright?
Can you stand? Here, take my hand.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Looks like you're not hurt, thank goodness.
Fufu, did you get overwhelmed by that girl's fighting spirit?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You were worried about her, weren't you?
Don't worry. I'll go talk to her.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Pokke.
Taking a day off today?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Fuji-san... Yeah.
I decided I ain't doing jack for a while.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Surprisingly enough,
Jungle Pocket answered in a completely matter-of-fact tone.
There was no sign of panic or hesitation in her.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
The heat... the lingering aftermath of that last race...?
Feels like I'd get dragged down by all that.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
So I figured it's better to just completely
clear my head and reset for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
Yes, I believe that's a very wise judgment.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Right now, you're in the calm
after weathering a monumental clash.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Jungle Pocket had halted her feet
with clear, deliberate intention...
I couldn't help but feel impressed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For athletes, resting is also a battle against anxiety...
Some get restless out of fear that their body will lose its edge.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You aren't afraid, are you?
Perhaps you understand what truly matters purely by instinct.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...? Don't really get all that complicated stuff,
but if you say so, Fuji-san, then maybe you're right.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Either way, I'm gonna blow past everyone in the next race too.
So this is fine for now.
I can bring myself right back up to peak condition in no time!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu! Wonderful, that's the spirit.
You showed us a truly magnificent race, after all.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: So... I'll be expecting great things next time too!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Hell yeah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later—
I spotted Jungle Pocket on the grounds
for the first time in a while.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Alright! Warmed up and ready.
I'm gonna do it again.
The strongest around—is ME!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Jungle Pocket had brilliantly found a run
even greater than before.
She's sure to put on a show in her next race as well!
